title: promotion_audit
description: Output of deflate_sharpe.py. Deflated Sharpe Ratio audit for a candidate hypothesis (Bailey & López de Prado 2014). Written to runs/<run_id>/artifacts/promotion_audit.yaml.

hypothesis_id.description: Matches hypothesis_card.yaml hypothesis_id for the run being audited.

raw_median_sharpe.description: Candidate median Sharpe from protocol_result.yaml per_symbol_summary. Null on the sparse-trading path (below_floor_pct > 50%).

total_hypotheses_tested.description: Total deduplicated trial records in campaign_state.trial_sharpes at audit time (N in BLP 2014).

trial_sharpe_variance.description: Sample variance of the Sharpe-valid trial values used for DSR denominator estimation. Null when fewer than 2 valid trials exist.

deflated_sharpe_ratio.description: DSR = Φ((candidate_sr - E_max_SR) / sigma_SR). Range [0, 1]. Null when DSR cannot be computed (sparse path, insufficient trials, or zero trial variance).

correction_method.description: Citation for the multiple-testing correction applied.

promotion_threshold_raw.description: Expected maximum Sharpe (E_max_SR) — the Sharpe threshold in raw Sharpe space that the candidate must exceed to pass DSR > 0.95. Null on the sparse path or when DSR cannot be computed.

promotion_threshold_deflated.description: DSR threshold for promotion (0.95 for the Sharpe path). Fixed for all runs.

passes_deflated_threshold.description: True if DSR > 0.95 (Sharpe path) or t_stat > 2.0 (sparse/expectancy path).

excluded_trial_counts.description: Records excluded from Sharpe trial pool, broken down by reason.

no_sharpe_value.description: Trials with statistic_valid='sharpe' but sharpe field is null.

statistic_expectancy.description: Trials with statistic_valid='expectancy' (sparse-trading runs — not included in Sharpe pool).

statistic_neither.description: Trials with statistic_valid absent or set to an unrecognized value.

dedup_removed.description: Duplicate trial rows removed by (forecast_hash, source) deduplication before the DSR count.

invalidated_artifact.description: Trials excluded because invalidated_artifact=true (zero real hypothesis testing — e.g. divide-by-zero degenerate runs).

n_trials_used.description: Number of deduplicated Sharpe-valid trial values actually used in DSR computation.

total_campaign_runs.description: Total run attempts recorded in campaign.runs for this campaign — a distinct count from total_hypotheses_tested (the deduplicated trial-ledger N).

total_variants_tested.description: Number of valid (non-invalidated) trial records before deduplication. Used in the sparse-path Bonferroni note.

dsr_error.description: Diagnostic text explaining why the DSR could not be computed (insufficient trials, too few real Sharpe values, or zero trial variance). Present only on a non-happy DSR path; absent when DSR was computed.

is_sparse_trading.description: True when below_floor_pct > 50% — median_sharpe is unreliable and promotion decision routes through expectancy_promotion instead.

expected_max_sharpe.description: E_max_SR = mu_SR + sigma_SR * Z_exp_max. The expected maximum Sharpe over N independent trials. Present only on the Sharpe path with sufficient trials.

expectancy_promotion.description: Present when is_sparse_trading=true. Contains t-test result for per-trade expectancy.

t_stat.description: t_stat = expectancy_bps / expectancy_se. Null when expectancy_se is unavailable or zero.

bonferroni_note.description: Informational note on the strict Bonferroni threshold vs the 2.0 threshold used. Recorded for audit trail.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this audit was computed.
